notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Butcher Ghoul.
Zulaport Cutthorat.
Sifter of Skulls and Butcher Ghoul's undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion token.
Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Butcher Ghoul and drawing a card.
Repeat.
